attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Ohio state income tax per Form IT-1040. Ohio uses progressive tax brackets: 0% on income up to $26,050, 2.75% on income from $26,051 to $100,000, and 3.125% on income above $100,000. Personal exemptions vary by AGI: $2,350 (AGI up to $40,000), $2,100 (AGI $40,001 to $80,000), $1,850 (AGI over $80,000). Exemptions are per person (taxpayer, spouse, dependents) and phase out starting at $750,000 MAGI.

initial_action.action_dsl: add "OHIO FORM IT-1040 - State Income Tax Calculation" to job.audit_trail; set result.oh_agi = result.agi; set result.oh_bracket_1_tax = 0; set result.oh_bracket_2_tax = 0; set result.oh_bracket_3_tax = 0
initial_action.action_postfix: "OHIO FORM IT-1040 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.oh_agi xdef 0 /result.oh_bracket_1_tax xdef 0 /result.oh_bracket_2_tax xdef 0 /result.oh_bracket_3_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Calculate number of people for exemptions
condition_details.condition_dsl: number of job.taxpayers + number of job.dependents >= 1
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.taxpayers arraysize job.dependents arraysize + local@ num_people > num_people 1 >=

action_details.action_comment: Calculate OH tax with exemptions; Calculate Ohio AGI, apply tiered exemptions, calculate progressive tax
action_details.action_dsl: add " Starting Federal AGI: $" + result.oh_agi + " (Form 1040 Line 11)" to job.audit_trail; set result.oh_exemption_amount = oh_exemption_low; if result.oh_agi > oh_exemption_threshold_low then set result.oh_exemption_amount = oh_exemption_mid; endif; if result.oh_agi > oh_exemption_threshold_high then set result.oh_exemption_amount = oh_exemption_high; endif; if result.oh_agi >= oh_exemption_phaseout_threshold then set result.oh_exemption_amount = 0; endif; set result.oh_exemption_total = (number of job.taxpayers + number of job.dependents) * result.oh_exemption_amount; add " Personal Exemption: $" + result.oh_exemption_amount + " per person" to job.audit_trail; add " Total Exemptions: " + (number of job.taxpayers + number of job.dependents) + " x $" + result.oh_exemption_amount + " = $" + result.oh_exemption_total to job.audit_trail; set result.oh_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.oh_agi - result.oh_exemption_total) and 0; add " Ohio Taxable Income: $" + result.oh_taxable_income + " (AGI - Exemptions)" to job.audit_trail; set result.oh_bracket_1_tax = (the minimum of result.oh_taxable_income and oh_bracket_1_threshold) * oh_bracket_1_rate; set result.oh_bracket_2_tax = (the maximum of ((the minimum of result.oh_taxable_income and oh_bracket_2_threshold) - oh_bracket_1_threshold) and 0.0) * oh_bracket_2_rate; set result.oh_bracket_3_tax = (the maximum of (result.oh_taxable_income - oh_bracket_2_threshold) and 0.0) * oh_bracket_3_rate; set result.oh_tax = result.oh_bracket_1_tax + result.oh_bracket_2_tax + result.oh_bracket_3_tax; add " Bracket 1 (0% on $0-$26,050): $" + result.oh_bracket_1_tax to job.audit_trail; add " Bracket 2 (2.75% on $26,051-$100,000): $" + result.oh_bracket_2_tax to job.audit_trail; add " Bracket 3 (3.125% above $100,000): $" + result.oh_bracket_3_tax to job.audit_trail; add " Total Ohio Tax: $" + result.oh_tax + " (Form IT-1040)" to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.oh_agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.oh_agi oh_exemption_phaseout_threshold f>= if 0 /result.oh_exemption_amount xdef " Personal Exemption: $0 (AGI >= $750,000 - phased out)" job.audit_trail swap addto else result.oh_agi oh_exemption_threshold_high f> if oh_exemption_high /result.oh_exemption_amount xdef else result.oh_agi oh_exemption_threshold_low f> if oh_exemption_mid /result.oh_exemption_amount xdef else oh_exemption_low /result.oh_exemption_amount xdef endif endif " Personal Exemption: $" result.oh_exemption_amount cvs strconcat " per person" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto endif num_people result.oh_exemption_amount f* /result.oh_exemption_total xdef " Total Exemptions: " num_people cvs strconcat " x $" strconcat result.oh_exemption_amount cvs strconcat " = $" strconcat result.oh_exemption_total cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.oh_agi result.oh_exemption_total f- 0 fmax /result.oh_taxable_income xdef " Ohio Taxable Income: $" result.oh_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (AGI - Exemptions)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.oh_taxable_income oh_bracket_2_threshold f> if oh_bracket_1_threshold oh_bracket_1_rate f* /result.oh_bracket_1_tax xdef oh_bracket_2_threshold oh_bracket_1_threshold f- oh_bracket_2_rate f* /result.oh_bracket_2_tax xdef result.oh_taxable_income oh_bracket_2_threshold f- oh_bracket_3_rate f* /result.oh_bracket_3_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (0% on $0-$26,050): $" result.oh_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (2.75% on $26,051-$100,000): $" result.oh_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 3 (3.125% above $100,000): $" result.oh_bracket_3_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.oh_taxable_income oh_bracket_1_threshold f> if oh_bracket_1_threshold oh_bracket_1_rate f* /result.oh_bracket_1_tax xdef result.oh_taxable_income oh_bracket_1_threshold f- oh_bracket_2_rate f* /result.oh_bracket_2_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (0% on $0-$26,050): $" result.oh_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (2.75% on $26,051-$" result.oh_taxable_income cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.oh_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.oh_taxable_income oh_bracket_1_rate f* /result.oh_bracket_1_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (0% on $0-$" result.oh_taxable_income cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.oh_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto endif endif result.oh_bracket_1_tax result.oh_bracket_2_tax f+ result.oh_bracket_3_tax f+ /result.oh_tax xdef " Total Ohio Tax: $" result.oh_tax cvs strconcat " (Form IT-1040)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No exemptions - unlikely case; Calculate OH tax without exemptions
action_details.action_dsl: add " Ohio AGI: $" + result.oh_agi to job.audit_trail; set result.oh_taxable_income = the maximum of result.oh_agi and 0; set result.oh_bracket_1_tax = (the minimum of result.oh_taxable_income and oh_bracket_1_threshold) * oh_bracket_1_rate; set result.oh_bracket_2_tax = (the maximum of ((the minimum of result.oh_taxable_income and oh_bracket_2_threshold) - oh_bracket_1_threshold) and 0.0) * oh_bracket_2_rate; set result.oh_bracket_3_tax = (the maximum of (result.oh_taxable_income - oh_bracket_2_threshold) and 0.0) * oh_bracket_3_rate; set result.oh_tax = result.oh_bracket_1_tax + result.oh_bracket_2_tax + result.oh_bracket_3_tax; add " Ohio Tax: $" + result.oh_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: " Ohio AGI: $" result.oh_agi cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.oh_agi 0 fmax /result.oh_taxable_income xdef result.oh_taxable_income oh_bracket_2_threshold f> if oh_bracket_1_threshold oh_bracket_1_rate f* /result.oh_bracket_1_tax xdef oh_bracket_2_threshold oh_bracket_1_threshold f- oh_bracket_2_rate f* /result.oh_bracket_2_tax xdef result.oh_taxable_income oh_bracket_2_threshold f- oh_bracket_3_rate f* /result.oh_bracket_3_tax xdef else result.oh_taxable_income oh_bracket_1_threshold f> if oh_bracket_1_threshold oh_bracket_1_rate f* /result.oh_bracket_1_tax xdef result.oh_taxable_income oh_bracket_1_threshold f- oh_bracket_2_rate f* /result.oh_bracket_2_tax xdef else result.oh_taxable_income oh_bracket_1_rate f* /result.oh_bracket_1_tax xdef endif endif result.oh_bracket_1_tax result.oh_bracket_2_tax f+ result.oh_bracket_3_tax f+ /result.oh_tax xdef " Ohio Tax: $" result.oh_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
